    BO13a Lemma 6, case II.C (β): σ₂ = σ₂' ≫ u₂' and ρₙ factors through the last arrow of u₂ but not through u₂. With u₂ = a ≫ b and ρₙ = ρₙ' ≫ b for the longest such suffix b: the star ψ, σ₂' ; a, u₂' if σ₂' ≫ a ≠ 0; otherwise figure 6.16 (Ẽ₆) if σₙ does not factor through ρₙ', figure 6.17 if ρ₂ does not factor through σ₂' (with an arrow φ for ρ₂ if ρ₂ ≅ σ), figure 6.18 (D̃₅) or the star ψ, σ₂' ; ρ₂', u₂' (all in P/σ).
